exact_scope.classification: same raw-source complete marked-word joint L2 state, complex linear isometry and generated Born measure producer
exact_scope.raw_input: The exact same286 RawKrausWindow contains seven primitive fields: left/right, their order, raw continuous halfHamiltonian A(t), all J(t), and their two continuity statements. E is nontrivial complete complex Hilbert and iota finite; total-mass/state mouths take an in-window start and original vector x. No completed U, state, density, measure, normalizer, coverage or per-fiber realization is input.
exact_scope.whole_carrier: WordChart is Sigma n(Fin n→iota); WordHistory adds every original Fin n real-time tuple. All finite lengths including0 and all source Kraus letters are retained. baseMeasure is generated by the sum of original strict-simplex Pi-Lebesgue restrictions mapped to these disjoint charts, with no finite-length/time sampling cutoff.
exact_scope.same_source_function: wordFunction is exactly qualified290.amplitude on that same n, word and real-time tuple applied to x; no new source, independent selected restricted flow or changed normalizer is inserted. Its full norm mass uses already certified289/290 all-word results.
exact_scope.Born_mass: bornDensity is ofReal of the original norm-square. bornMeasure is the generated baseMeasure.withDensity. Its total mass equals ofReal(norm(x)^2), hence is finite for every x. The probability theorem additionally requires norm(x)=1 of the original input vector. This is not a probability claim for arbitrary unnormalized x.
exact_scope.L2_and_linearity: MemLp2 and wave are generated from the same wordFunction and its proved integrability; wave_ae identifies the representative. wave_norm, wave_add and wave_smul generate sourceIsometry:E→linear-isometry[complex] Lp(E,2,baseMeasure). No completed isometry or normalized wave is supplied.
exact_scope.topological_scope: The scalar Born density/mass/finite/probability chain does not require an E measurable/Borel/second-countable instance. E-valued wordFunction measurability and scalar squared integrability use MeasurableSpace E and BorelSpace E. The actual L2 wave/MemLp/sourceIsometry retain SecondCountableTopology E as well, exactly as printed.
exact_scope.n0_and_zero_width: The entire all-n carrier and source ordered endpoints retain the certified290 vacuum/zero-width scope; no nonempty-word or positive-duration premise is added.
exact_scope.direct_consumers: The separately SOURCE-approved293 symmetrization reads this same wordFunction, then derives its full-coordinate Fock function. Native293 and later physical consumers remain separately qualified.
